# Artwork and fonts

The three originals were supplied by the user. They are included unchanged under ASCII filenames:

| Packaged original | Supplied filename | Role in this theme |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `originals/green-white-floral.svg` | Green and White Elegant Wedding Invitation.svg | Grey paper `#efeeed`, ivory roses and foliage |
| `originals/green-botanical-graduation.svg` | Beige Simple Minimalist Floral Graduation Party Invitation.svg | Deep green `#20443b` and engraved botanical corner |
| `originals/graduation-cap-card.svg` | Black and Beige Doodle Minimalist Illustrated Happy Graduation Greeting Card.svg | Graduation cap, diploma and surrounding illustration |

Extracted artwork keeps its original aspect ratio. The cap’s fill was changed to the theme’s deep green. Vector copies remain in `assets/`; WebP renderings are used in the self-contained preview to reduce its size. The uploaded source files themselves were not recoloured or edited. No new third-party photographs are included; the portrait area accepts the graduate’s own image.

The existing project’s Playfair Display regular/italic, Amiri and Ballet font assets are reused. Their embedded attribution is recorded in `font-metadata.json`. The UI uses system fonts. The original uploaded artwork retains its existing ownership and applicable terms.
